title: Non-Stick For First 3-4 Uses
text: Non-Stick For First 3-4 Uses. I'm one of those people that reads the instruction book from start to finish and keep the book... That said, I follow the care directions to the letter. After 3-4 uses, I noticed a ring inside the pan where the heating element is underneath. That ring now burns everything and everything sticks to it!  So it is a 'partially non-stick pan'.  No longer is it 'Simply wipe clean', now it is 'Soak for a long time and use sponge scraper or plastic spatula to clean'.  No more Bella products for me! Two strikes and you are out!
